baseline_note: Mechanisms reviewed against the linked primary sources. Original synthetic data, algebraic derivations and SVG illustrations; numerical curves computed by the accompanying Python standard-library scripts. Hand updates, finite-difference gradients and deterministic full-batch training were executed. Framework source baselines are evidence references, not an installed or tested PyTorch dependency combination. The PyTorch comparison snippet was not executed. No real dataset, hardware, model benchmark or deployed runtime is validated. Dynamic web dates are the displayed last-updated dates; no web-page mirror is stored.

claims.section: 3 梯度怎样从误差算出来
claims.statement: MSE partial derivatives with respect to slope and intercept; article derives chain-rule factors and half-MSE coefficients.
Current-gradient descent update in parameter space; local synthetic full-rank quadratic example and its unique minimizer are derived in the article.

claims.section: 5 学习率为什么会改变结果
claims.statement: Learning-rate magnitude, full-batch versus stochastic and mini-batch updates; optimizer naming does not prescribe batch size.
Fitting the training data is distinct from evaluation on independently held-out data.
